analyst.summary: Waaree Renewable Technologies is the solar EPC business within the Waaree group, growing fast on the back of India's solar capacity build-out, with a large and growing order book and excellent returns on capital. Management has also moved to acquire a transmission-infrastructure company, addressing a real bottleneck (grid connection delays) for solar projects. The very high trailing growth rates reflect rapid scaling from a smaller base and should not be assumed to continue at the same pace, but the underlying business looks well-managed. We rate it a Hold.
